Do not add characters the scene does not mention.
image_rules_en.nobody: Draw no people and no characters at all (no drop-shaped characters either). Books and papers carry no writing.
image_rules_en.always: All characters are simple drop-shaped figures with dot eyes and a small mouth: no clothes, no hair, smooth one-color bodies (only the main character's green scarf is an exception). Show age only with small props such as reading glasses, a cane or a bag. Draw exactly as many characters as the scene says. Never draw realistic humans.
